title: Text Generation: A Systematic Literature Review of Tasks, Evaluation, and Challenges
measurement_description: The paper surveys the literature on text generation and its challenges, including the measurement of bias. It specifically mentions that datasets like BOLD and FairPrim are used to measure various biases, including those related to 'religious belief'.
findings: As part of a broad systematic review of text generation, the paper identifies bias as a major challenge. It notes that 'religious belief' is one of the dimensions of bias (alongside profession, gender, race, and political ideology) that can be measured using datasets like BOLD and FairPrim. The paper also points out that not all biases are easy to measure with current metrics due to a lack of specific labeled data.
